copy.curiosityHook: Conan's mission seems straightforward, but Queen Taramis has secretly marked both him and the princess for betrayal once the magical horn is found.
copy.description: Hired by Queen Taramis to guide a young princess and her bodyguard on a perilous quest for the magical Horn of Dagoth, Conan embarks across sword-and-sorcery lands unaware of a deadly scheme awaiting their return.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast, exciting sword-and-sorcery adventure with spirited comic relief, built for an easygoing watch with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Richard Fleischer balances classic fantasy combat with dynamic swordplay, pitting a colorful band of eccentric allies against supernatural perils at an exhilarating, fast pace.

allowedMaterial: Quest to retrieve the magic Horn of Dagoth
Secret plot to sacrifice the princess and betray Conan
Allies including wizard Akiro, warrior woman Zula, and Malak
Battles against mortal and supernatural foes
excludedMaterial: Fate of the princess and bodyguard
